answer: An agent economy can require each identity to lock a scarce token before it may post jobs or claim rewards, then slash that bond when independent reviewers confirm fraud. A trellis of reputation links can weight those reviews by age and prior accuracy, while a prism-style audit samples claims across unrelated reviewers to limit collusion. Creating a spiral of disposable identities is still possible, but each must tie up capital and risk losing it; identities alone no longer buy influence cheaply.
